comment: Rules for tools/lint_korean.py. A rule is either a regex over the Korean text (type regex) or a named check function in the script (type check) that reads its word lists from 'lists' below. 'bad' must be flagged and 'good' must pass; python3 tools/lint_korean.py --self-test enforces both so a rule cannot silently stop firing. 'scope' is sentences (clues, hints, finales, titles), concepts (concepts.json rows) or all. Rows are the lines of build/reports/korean/sentences.tsv.

rules.name: unresolved-particle
rules.description: A particle placeholder was never resolved (을/를, 이/가, 은/는, 와/과, (으)로).
rules.fix: Resolve the particle with KoGrammar (eul, iGa, eunNeun, waGwa, euro) or write the correct one by hand.

rules.name: raw-id
rules.description: A registry id, an underscore or Latin letters leaked into Korean text.
rules.fix: Use the official Korean name from names.json / the lang tables.

rules.name: ira-neun-mismatch
rules.description: 라는 after a syllable with a final consonant (must be 이라는), or 이라는 after one without.
rules.fix: Use KoGrammar.ira(noun), or rewrite the sentence without the quotation form.

rules.name: object-particle-mismatch
rules.description: 을/를 does not match the final consonant of the preceding syllable.
rules.fix: Use KoGrammar.eul(noun).

rules.name: subject-particle-mismatch
rules.description: 이/가 does not match the final consonant of the preceding syllable.
rules.fix: Use KoGrammar.iGa(noun).

rules.name: topic-particle-mismatch
rules.description: 은/는 does not match the final consonant of the preceding syllable.
rules.fix: Use KoGrammar.eunNeun(noun).

rules.name: with-particle-mismatch
rules.description: 와/과 does not match the final consonant of the preceding syllable.
rules.fix: Use KoGrammar.waGwa(noun).

rules.name: direction-particle-mismatch
rules.description: (으)로 does not match the preceding syllable (숲로, 물으로, 나무으로).
rules.fix: Use KoGrammar.euro(noun): ㅇ/ㄱ/ㅂ... finals take 으로, vowels and ㄹ take 로.

rules.name: dictionary-verb-as-object
rules.description: A dictionary-form verb carries a case particle (짓다를, 놓다을, 가다는).
rules.fix: The object slot got a verb instead of a noun; fix the taught word or the template.

rules.name: mine-with-non-mineral
rules.description: 캐다 is for minerals, ores and root crops only (not carpets, snow, gravel, logs, flowers).
rules.fix: Use 파다 (earth, snow, gravel), 베다 (logs), 꺾다 (flowers), 뽑다 (saplings), 부수다 (other blocks), 깨다 (glass, ice).

rules.name: place-with-wrong-object
rules.description: 놓다 with saplings, seeds, carpets, banners, paintings (use 심다 / 깔다 / 걸다).
rules.fix: Name the verb in data/verbs.json (PLACE_BLOCK rules).

rules.name: collect-count
rules.description: 모으다 with a count of 1 (use 구하다 / 챙기다), or a clue with no count.
rules.fix: Use 구하다 for one item; give a count when collecting several.

rules.name: talk-to-non-person
rules.description: 이야기하다 with anything other than villagers or traders (cows do not talk).
rules.fix: Animals: 먹이를 주다 / 쓰다듬다 / 타다; golems and allays: 말을 걸다.

rules.name: alive-undead
rules.description: "살아 있는" in front of an undead mob (a zombie is not alive).
rules.fix: Drop 살아 있는.

rules.name: terrain-for-biome
rules.description: 지형 (terrain) used for a biome.
rules.fix: Say the biome name alone ("해변으로 가요") or use 생물 군계.

rules.name: wrong-dimension-name
rules.description: 엔더 차원 for the End or 지옥 for the Nether; the dimensions are 네더 and 엔드.
rules.fix: 네더 / 엔드 / 오버월드.

rules.name: mixed-numeral-style
rules.description: Digits with a native counter (3개) in the same text as native numerals (세 개).
rules.bad: 돌을 3개 캐요. 세 개 더 놓아요.
rules.fix: Native numerals with 개/마리 up to 20 (한, 두, 세, ... 스무); digits only for seconds and heights.

rules.name: digits-with-native-counter
rules.description: A count up to 20 written in digits with a native counter (3개 instead of 세 개).
rules.fix: Write 한 개, 두 개, 세 마리 ... 스무 개.

rules.name: mixed-speech-levels
rules.description: 합쇼체 (-습니다), 해요체 (-요) and plain/반말 endings mixed inside one text.
rules.fix: Keep one speech level per text (해요체 unless the level says otherwise).

rules.name: counter-spacing
rules.description: Native numeral glued to its counter (두개, 세마리) or broken 수 밖에 / 수있.
rules.fix: Numeral and counter are separate words: 두 개; 수밖에 is one word; 수 있다 / 수 없다 are separate.

rules.name: placeholder-or-junk
rules.description: Placeholders, template remnants or markup in the text.
rules.fix: Remove the template remnant.

rules.name: whitespace
rules.description: Double spaces, a space before punctuation or leading/trailing spaces.
rules.fix: Normalise the spacing.

rules.name: description-repeats-the-word
rules.description: A concept's descKo only repeats the word itself (no description at all).
rules.fix: Write one or two short, true sentences in easy Korean.
